description: Searches Salesforce leads by name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead source, combining supplied criteria with OR. Without criteria, it returns recent non-converted leads; partial matches may return multiple candidates, so confirm identifying fields before using a lead ID.

company.description: Search by company name. Supports partial matches.
company.human_parameter_description: Enter the company name the lead works for. Partial names are fine if you’re not sure of the exact spelling.
company.title: Company

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.
email.human_parameter_description: Enter an email address or part of one to find matching leads. You can use a full address or a domain like '@gmail.com'.
email.title: Email

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Lead fields to retrieve.
fields.human_parameter_description: Specify which lead fields to include in the results. Use a comma-separated list to customize the columns you want back.
fields.title: Fields

lead_source.human_parameter_description: Choose how the lead was acquired, like Web or Phone Inquiry. This helps filter leads by their origin.
lead_source.title: Lead Source

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return. Maximum cap is 2000; for result sets beyond 2000, use salesforce.run_soql_query with pagination via nextRecordsUrl.
limit.human_parameter_description: Set the maximum number of leads to return. Lower values give faster, more focused results.
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Search by lead name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.
name.human_parameter_description: Enter the lead’s name to search for. You can provide a full name or just part of it to broaden the results.
name.title: Name

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.
phone.human_parameter_description: Enter a phone number or partial digits to look up leads by phone. Area codes or fragments work too.
phone.title: Phone

status.human_parameter_description: Select the lead status you want to filter by, such as Open or Working. Use this to narrow results to a specific stage.
status.title: Status

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.
title.human_parameter_description: Enter the job title you want to match, like Manager or Director. Partial titles are accepted.
title.title: Title

name: search_leads

LeadRecord.description: A Salesforce Lead record with all available fields.

Website.description: Website URL associated with the lead's company.
Website.title: Website

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the record has been deleted.
IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

Latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the lead's address.
Latitude.title: Latitude

IsConverted.description: Indicates whether the lead has been converted to an Account, Contact, and optionally an Opportunity.
IsConverted.title: Is Converted

Salutation.description: Salutation for the lead (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.).
Salutation.title: Salutation

attributes.description: Metadata about the record including object type and API URL.
attributes.title: Attributes

Phone.description: Primary phone number of the lead.
Phone.title: Phone

Jigsaw.description: Data.com Key used for integration with Data.com (formerly Jigsaw). Should not be manually modified.
Jigsaw.title: Jigsaw

LeadSource.description: Source of the lead (e.g., Website, Referral, Advertisement).
LeadSource.title: Lead Source

Status.description: Current status of the lead in the sales cycle (picklist field with values like Open, Contacted, Qualified, etc.).
Status.title: Status

Description.description: Description or notes about the lead.
Description.title: Description

CreatedDate.description: Date and time when the lead record was created. ISO 8601 format.
CreatedDate.title: Created Date

Company.description: Company name of the lead. This is a required field and becomes the Account name upon conversion.
Company.title: Company

OwnerId.description: ID of the User or Queue that owns this lead record.
OwnerId.title: Owner Id

ConvertedAccountId.description: ID of the Account created from the lead conversion.
ConvertedAccountId.title: Converted Account Id

StateCode.description: State code when State and Country/Territory Picklists are enabled.
StateCode.title: State Code

LastActivityDate.description: Date of the most recent activity (task or event) associated with the lead. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
LastActivityDate.title: Last Activity Date

AnnualRevenue.description: Annual revenue of the lead's company.
AnnualRevenue.title: Annual Revenue

LastModifiedById.description: ID of the User who last modified the lead record.
LastModifiedById.title: Last Modified By Id

MasterRecordId.description: ID of the master record when leads are merged. Records with this field set are in the Recycle Bin.
MasterRecordId.title: Master Record Id

ConvertedContactId.description: ID of the Contact created from the lead conversion.
ConvertedContactId.title: Converted Contact Id

CreatedById.description: ID of the User who created the lead record.
CreatedById.title: Created By Id

ConvertedDate.description: Date when the lead was converted. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
ConvertedDate.title: Converted Date

CountryCode.description: Country code when State and Country/Territory Picklists are enabled.
CountryCode.title: Country Code

State.description: State or province of the lead's address.
State.title: State

SystemModstamp.description: Date and time when the lead record was last modified by a user or automated process. Always >= LastModifiedDate. ISO 8601 format.
SystemModstamp.title: System Modstamp

JigsawContactId.description: Data.com contact identifier for the lead.
JigsawContactId.title: Jigsaw Contact Id

NumberOfEmployees.description: Number of employees at the lead's company.
NumberOfEmployees.title: Number Of Employees

ConvertedOpportunityId.description: ID of the Opportunity created from the lead conversion (may be null if no opportunity was created).
ConvertedOpportunityId.title: Converted Opportunity Id

Rating.description: Rating of the lead (picklist field with values like Hot, Warm, Cold).
Rating.title: Rating

Id.description: Unique identifier of the Lead record.
Id.title: Id

PhotoUrl.description: Relative URL to the lead's photo. Combine with instance URL to get the full image URL. Available when Chatter is enabled.
PhotoUrl.title: Photo Url

LastName.description: Last name of the lead. This is a required field for Lead creation.
LastName.title: Last Name

Longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the lead's address.
Longitude.title: Longitude

Name.description: Read-only compound field composed from Salutation, FirstName, and LastName based on locale settings.
Name.title: Name

PostalCode.description: Postal or zip code of the lead's address.
PostalCode.title: Postal Code

MobilePhone.description: Mobile phone number of the lead.
MobilePhone.title: Mobile Phone

Title.description: Title or position of the lead.
Title.title: Title

LastModifiedDate.description: Date and time when the lead record was last modified by a user. ISO 8601 format.
LastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

LeadRecord.title: LeadRecord

LeadRecordAttributes.description: Metadata about the Lead record including object type and API URL.

type.description: The Salesforce object type, always 'Lead' for Lead records.
type.title: Type

url.description: The REST API endpoint path to access this specific Lead record.
url.title: Url

LeadRecordAttributes.title: LeadRecordAttributes

SearchLeadsResponse.description: Response from Salesforce SOQL query containing Lead records.

done.description: Indicates whether all results have been retrieved. When false, additional batches remain available.
done.title: Done

nextRecordsUrl.description: The URL path to fetch the next batch of results when done is false. Absent when done is true.
nextRecordsUrl.title: Next Records Url

records.description: Array containing the Lead records returned by the query (up to 2000 records per batch).
records.title: Records

totalSize.description: The total number of records that match the query criteria across all pages.
totalSize.title: Total Size
